verdict.rationale: A probe finds an official Stripe CLI documented at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli. Radar is part of Stripe, but the evidence never shows the CLI exposing Radar resources such as reviews, value lists, rules or early fraud warnings. Support therefore rests on a single thin probe line. Missing for 10: evidence that the CLI covers Radar-specific commands, documentation of AI-native or agentic CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
